# docs-link-check

> Check links in Markdown documentation: relative files with exact case, heading anchors with GitHub slugs, root escapes, and external URLs through an injected HTTP checker with caching Python package `trysac-docs-link-check`, import name `docs_link_check`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
